# AudioShare USB

AudioShare USB turns an Android phone into a speaker for ordinary Windows audio
over a physical USB cable and authenticated ADB forwarding.

End-user rule: guide users to the portable Windows release ZIP. Do not require
cloning, Android Studio, Flutter, Gradle, or an APK build. The ZIP already
contains audioshare.exe, ADB, and the matching signed companion APK.

Authoritative beginner and AI setup instructions:
- https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare/blob/main/docs/AI_ASSISTANT_SETUP.md
- https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
- https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md

Related Android companion source (developers only):
- https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare-Android

Normal flow: download the latest AudioShare-USB-Windows-*.zip release asset;
extract all files to a user-writable folder; enable Android Developer Options
and USB debugging; connect and unlock the phone with a data cable; authorize
the PC; run audioshare.exe without admin; click Install companion if offered;
then wait for auto-connect or click Connect and raise phone media volume.

Security and platform constraints: USB only; no INTERNET or microphone
permission in the companion; no firewall weakening; no silent companion
installation; normal operation should not need admin. A missing OEM USB/ADB
driver and exclusive/ASIO/protected audio are external limitations.
